next_action.description: Live-verify the migration in the Electron app. Start with Qwen pose (wf_type 3) because its OpenPose annotator weights have never downloaded on this machine, so a missing-weight stall shows up there first. Then Qwen depth and edit, then all six Krea2 ops on BOTH the SFW and NSFW cards, then a Klein regression pass (Klein's injection surface was unchanged, so it should be untouched - prove it). For each op confirm the OUTPUT MATCHES THE OPERATION, not merely that it produced an image: a wrong Input_wf_type does not error, it silently returns a plausible image from a different op. Also confirm the turbo toggle still changes speed (it now sends Input_is_Turbo boolean, not the old Input_Tier int) and that Krea2 edit honours a painted mask.

key_decisions: poseReference renamed to depth, and a real pose op added. The old name always drove a DEPTH map and became actively wrong once Qwen gained real pose. User explicitly chose this over the smaller-diff alternative. poseReference stays in operationRegistry.js as deprecated:true - the established pattern used by change/remove - so history items written by <=1.3.0 still validate and stay viewable. Nothing may WRITE that key again.

New ops stamped appVersionIntroduced 1.4.0. v1.3.0 is tagged and published, new ops are a 2nd-digit bump. Safe because nothing gates on the field at runtime - isOperationAvailableIn has no callers in js/; only the release-notes lister getOperationsIntroducedIn reads it. depth is a RENAME not a feature, so keep it out of user-facing release notes.

Masks on the edit ops needed ZERO code. maskDataUrl is attached whenever the canvas has a mask (MpiGroupHistoryBlock, op-agnostic) and commandExecutor sets Input_Mask unconditionally, so the graph carrying the node is the whole feature. Deliberately NOT requiresMask - that flag would FORCE a mask and break whole-image edits.

Krea2 lost its progressStages total on purpose. The table is keyed by FILE and all six ops now share one file; detail (MaskDetailerPipe) and upscale (UltimateSDUpscale, one bar per tile) emit more bars than t2i's two, so a single number would render 'Stage 3/2'. Krea2 now shows '. 2' like Klein. postTile:1 survives on the krea2_t2i.json key because phaseProgress only reads it once tile mode is entered, so it is inert on the other five ops.
Input_depth_strength is deliberately NOT injected and NOT scrubbed - the app never sends it, so the graph's authored value is the intended one and scrubbing would zero a real setting.
constraints: THE FAILURE MODE IS SILENT. A missing or wrong Input_wf_type does not error - it runs the graph's default branch and returns a plausible image from the WRONG operation. Verification must check that the output matches the op, not just that an image appeared.

Qwen's authoring template bakes Input_wf_type: 3 (pose). generate_qwen.py rebakes it to 1 and raises if the node did not survive the prune - this actually fired during the bake. If anyone re-exports Qwen, that rebake is what stands between them and 'every op runs pose'.

Agents NEVER hand-edit workflow JSON. Dangling injection nodes get fixed in the ComfyUI graph editor and re-exported. For a SOURCE node with no matching input (an MpiString like Input_Image_3), MUTE (Ctrl+M) is cleaner than BYPASS (Ctrl+B) - bypass tries to rewire an upstream that does not exist. Both are dropped by the converter.

scripts/sync-raw-workflows.mjs REFUSES to run while generated-workflow files are uncommitted, because orchestrate.py rebuilds all templates and would overwrite them. Commit the generators first. It also commits raw/ itself as step 2 and leaves generated files staged but uncommitted.

board.json FAILS a JSON round-trip guard (CRLF plus formatting), so never rewrite it with JSON.stringify - it would reformat the whole file and clobber the peer's in-flight edits. Use surgical string edits. Also note .agents/mpi-kanban/events.jsonl has 2 pre-existing blank lines at HEAD - not corruption, do not 'fix' them.
Tests run as: node --test "tests/*.test.cjs" (glob, quoted). node --test tests/ BREAKS on Node v24. Documented at docs/DEVELOPMENT.md:36.

release-baselines/*.json still name the deleted krea2 detailer/upscaler files. That is CORRECT - they are manifests of the shipped 1.3.0 artifact, not references to the current tree. Do not 'fix' them (see MPI-409).

Qwen has NO prompt enhancer (no TextGenerate node, no Input_enhance_prompt) and that is deliberate, user-confirmed 2026-08-02. capabilities.promptEnhance stays false. Do not 'add the missing enhancer'.

Klein required NO app-side change - its injection surface was byte-identical across the re-export (23 titles, 0 added, 0 removed). Its 21 new nodes are internal rewiring. Treat any Klein breakage as a regression, not as expected migration fallout.
